items.title: Israel mourns Oct. 7 attacks as Palestinians in Gaza live in ruins of war

items.title: Canadian buoy found on shore of Irish island after journey across Atlantic
items.excerpt: Officials in northwestern Ireland say they're working to recover a large Canadian buoy that floated across the Atlantic Ocean and washed up on a coastal island.

items.title: Nobel Prize in chemistry goes to Kagan and Saoi for solving molecular mystery
items.excerpt: Scientists paid tribute to Kagan and Soai's groundbreaking work, which the Nobel committee described as a feat never previously achieved by anyone “other than life itself.”

items.title: ‘Tinder Swindler’ Simon Leviev plans to launch dating app

items.title: Ukraine preparing for Russian aerial attack, launches nearly 900 drones

items.title: 7th terror suspect arrested in UK after incident at U.S. military base

items.title: Cornell president calls alleged gang rape ‘deeply disturbing,’ pledges greater transparency

items.title: Dual UK-Iranian national released on bail over suspected plot against US-run military base
